newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Piedmont Bancorp Inc Q4 net lower.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Piedmont Bancorp Inc Q4 net lower.

text.p: (In thousands, except share and per share data)
NOTE: (1) Earnings per share are only presented for periods subsequent to the conversion on December 7, 1995, which includes net earnings from December 8, 1995, through June 30, 1996.
(2) Weighted average number of shares of common stock outstanding since the conversion on December 7, 1995.

(3) Current year earnings were adversely affected by several non-recurring items. Excluding non-recurring items, return on average assets for the year totaled about 1.27 percent and return on average equity for the year totaled about 6.06 percent. Additionally, earnings per share would have been about $0.61 per share for the year ended June 30, 1997, with the exclusion of non-recurring items.
